answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrowed vault, while correlated equivocation links signatures, timing, and funding flows. If k identities coordinate conflicting votes, their aggregate penalty scales as O(k^2), making collusion costlier than isolated faults. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, producing hollow accounts and deterring cheap replication across the network lagoon.
